name: ThornBacks
source:
ThornBacks set in 2001 in the remote Welsh countryside, "Cryptid Chaser" Jody is invited to a crumbling old, academy where the headmistress is having hell trying to dispose of the academy's pride and joy... an ancient rose....

[From [url=https://3llix.itch.io/thornbacks-unfinished-horror-vn]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《ThornBacks》的故事发生在2001年，地点是威尔士偏远的乡间。“神秘生物追踪者”Jody受邀来到一所破败的古老学院。女校长正为清除学院引以为傲的珍宝而焦头烂额……那是一株古老的玫瑰……

[摘自[url=https://3llix.itch.io/thornbacks-unfinished-horror-vn]Itch.io[/url]]
